purpose: Source-reviewed scalar symmetric-pair specializations; pending proof work, not outcomes.

items.shape: op(op(Z,select(c,X,Y)),select(c,Y,X)) -> op(op(X,Y),Z), with original operand positions preserved as the source mutates them
items.scope: Commutative associative integer add/mul/and/or/xor; source inner one-use. Drop output poison flags. Complementary min/max siblings are additional modeled variants. FP/PHI outside scalar scope. All operand orders require explicit coverage.
items.notes: Rebuilding one-use inner op and outer root is an equivalent Puddle DAG replacement, even though C++ mutates two existing nodes.

items.scope: Check pinned IntrinsicInst::isCommutative before choosing concrete supported intrinsic IDs. Min/max, saturating add and other candidates require source dispatch verification; no generic call proof. Opposite min/max sibling variants also need proof.
items.notes: Model scalar dedicated intrinsic opcodes, preserve exact source flag dropping, and document remaining unmodeled intrinsic/PHI/vector cases separately.
